nodes.label: n8n Runtime
nodes.role: System execution boundary for the n8n UI, REST API, webhook endpoints, schedules, and imported workflows.
constraints: Local file access is constrained by N8N_RESTRICT_FILE_ACCESS_TO.
Secrets and the n8n SQLite database are intentionally not committed.
No Redis or external queue-mode configuration is present in tracked runtime files.

evidence.detail: Defines the official n8n container, port, environment, project mount, and persistent n8n_data volume.
Starts the locally installed n8n binary with project file access.

nodes.label: Daily Keyword News Summary
nodes.role: Primary collection workflow: accepts schedule/manual/webhook triggers, assembles keywords, fetches RSS, filters articles, writes review artifacts and structured records, and promotes automatic keywords.
constraints: The workflow writes instructions but does not call an AI API.
Explicit webhook keywords override manual, automatic, and talent-derived defaults.
Promoted keywords affect later executions, not the execution that discovered them.

evidence.detail: Builds Google News, Hatena, and PANORA feed requests.
Writes digest and review instruction artifacts.

nodes.label: Apply Talent Index Proposal
nodes.role: Validates a reviewed talent/article proposal and upserts articles, talents, and many-to-many article_talents rows.
constraints: Only reviewed JSON should be submitted.
New discovered talents must remain pending and search-disabled until approval.
Exported Data Table IDs are environment-specific.

nodes.label: Apply Article Classification Proposal
nodes.role: Resolves proposal URLs to existing articles, validates taxonomy fields, and upserts article classifications.
constraints: Classification requires evidence and adequate confidence.
Secondary categories are limited and must differ from the primary category.
The classification table ID is supplied by environment variable.

evidence.detail: Validates proposals against existing articles and taxonomy.

nodes.label: Apply Article Feedback
nodes.role: Validates dashboard article decisions and upserts approved/rejected feedback used to exclude rejected articles from later daily outputs.
constraints: The article must already exist.
Rejected decisions require one supported reason code.
Feedback upserts by article key.

nodes.label: Auto Article Starter (legacy)
nodes.role: Earlier manual/webhook article-brief prototype retained for compatibility; superseded by the daily keyword workflow.
constraints: README explicitly marks this workflow as an earlier prototype.
It has no persisted output node in the exported definition.

evidence.detail: Documents the workflow as an earlier prototype.

nodes.label: Talent Dashboard Server
nodes.role: Local HTTP service that serves static dashboard pages, aggregates n8n SQLite and file archives, manages manual keywords, proxies runtime keyword mutations and feedback, and emits feedback instructions.
constraints: Binds to 127.0.0.1 by default.
Reads n8n SQLite in mode=ro; mutations use config file replacement or n8n webhooks.
Falls back to reviewed proposal files when required Data Tables are unavailable.

evidence.detail: Defines HTTP routing and static-file serving.
Handles manual and automatic keyword operations.

nodes.label: Talent Dashboard Web UI
nodes.role: Multi-page browser UI for dashboard metrics, talents, articles, article feedback, keyword management, AI candidates, and weekly reports.
constraints: Requires the local dashboard server APIs; direct file opening does not provide live data.
Page state is stored in browser sessionStorage.
All server writes are user initiated.

nodes.label: Workflow API Sync
nodes.role: CLI client that validates a local workflow export, finds or creates the target workflow, updates its structure through the n8n REST API, and optionally changes activation state.
constraints: Requires N8N_API_KEY for non-dry-run API operations.
Normal updates omit staticData and preserve runtime autoKeywords.
A remote workflow can contain newer UI edits that this tool overwrites.

evidence.detail: Loads and validates the local JSON definition.

nodes.label: Official Talent Registry Sync
nodes.role: Fetches configured official roster pages, parses source-specific structures, compares with local talents, writes audit snapshots/proposals, and optionally posts the proposal.
constraints: Only configured official source URLs are fetched.
Roster sync never deletes talents or marks unmatched records inactive.
Official entries default to search_enabled=false.

evidence.detail: Posts to the talent apply webhook.

nodes.label: Article Capture & Summary Backfill
nodes.role: Fetches saved article targets, resolves Google News URLs, captures normalized article text or public media metadata, writes resumable archives/summaries, and optionally upserts article_contents.
constraints: Content is capped at 100,000 characters.
Google News and publisher requests are rate-limited and retried.
Partial runs cannot overwrite daily summaries in the older backfill path.

evidence.detail: Captures one record with cache and content-type handling.
Upserts article_contents through the n8n Data Table API.

nodes.label: Review Output Generators
nodes.role: Offline generators for talent/classification proposals and article-feedback instruction Markdown, using structured records, body captures, and existing n8n rows.
constraints: Daily review generation refuses incomplete article/capture coverage.
Generated proposals remain review artifacts until explicitly applied.
The feedback generator imports dashboard server logic.

evidence.detail: Builds talent/article proposal JSON and Markdown.
Builds classification proposal JSON and Markdown.

nodes.label: Archive Backfill & Weekly Analysis
nodes.role: Backfills JSONL from historical digests and produces weekly trend and keyword-quality Markdown from structured records, reviewed classifications, and AI candidate decisions.
constraints: Historical JSONL is not overwritten without --force.
Reports inherit RSS-only and review-coverage limitations.
Classification ratios exclude unclassified articles.

evidence.detail: Converts one digest to run/article records.

nodes.label: Article Feedback Table Bootstrap
nodes.role: Idempotent CLI that checks for and creates the article_feedback n8n Data Table through the REST API.
constraints: Requires N8N_API_KEY.
Only the article_feedback table is managed.
Existing tables are left unchanged.

evidence.detail: Creates the table only when absent.

nodes.label: Repository Configuration
nodes.role: Git-tracked JSON configuration for manual/excluded keywords, organization roster sources/parsers, and the article classification taxonomy.
constraints: Files must remain valid JSON.
Manual keywords are the durable source of truth.
Organization parsing is limited to configured official sources.
Taxonomy requires evidence and AI review.

evidence.detail: Defines official roster sources and parser selection.

nodes.label: Content & Review Archive
nodes.role: File-backed boundary for daily digests, structured records, body captures, AI instructions, reviewed proposals, summaries, weekly reports, and analysis outputs.
constraints: Dated runtime artifacts are generated or manually reviewed and are excluded from the code fingerprint.
Same-date workflow runs may overwrite date-keyed outputs.
Proposal JSON must be reviewed before apply webhooks are called.

evidence.detail: Documents the archive structure and ownership.
Defines captured-content files and article_contents sync.

nodes.label: n8n SQLite & Data Tables
nodes.role: Local n8n persistence: SQLite metadata/workflow static data and logical Data Tables talents, articles, article_talents, article_classifications, article_feedback, and optional article_contents.
constraints: The SQLite file and table contents are outside Git.
Dashboard direct access is read-only.
Some exported workflow definitions contain local Data Table IDs.
article_classifications uses an environment-supplied table ID.

evidence.detail: Reads named Data Tables from SQLite in read-only mode.
Reads Daily Keyword News Summary staticData.

nodes.label: News RSS Sources
nodes.role: External Google News, Hatena Bookmark, and PANORA RSS endpoints queried for configured keywords.
constraints: Coverage is not a complete web search.
Feeds may return zero or noisy items.
No credentials are used by the current workflow.

nodes.label: Official Roster Sites
nodes.role: Configured public talent roster pages for Nijisanji, Hololive/Holostars, VSPO, Aogiri, Neo-Porte, Specialite, Replay, and Uomusume.
constraints: Only configured sites are in scope.
Markup changes can break source-specific parsers.
Network content is not versioned in this repository.

nodes.label: Article & Media Publishers
nodes.role: External article pages, Google News redirect endpoints, and public video/social metadata endpoints fetched during body capture.
constraints: Availability, robots policies, markup, and rate limits are external.
Unfetchable or short content is retained with failure/partial status.
Captured material is bounded and normalized.

evidence.detail: Classifies and captures an article target.

nodes.label: Human / AI Review Boundary
nodes.role: Manual evidence review step that converts generated AI instructions into approved proposal JSON/Markdown or weekly summaries before mutations are submitted.
constraints: Do not add facts absent from source evidence.
New talent candidates remain pending/search-disabled.
Only reviewed JSON is sent to apply workflows.
The specific AI provider and automation mechanism are not defined in repository code.

evidence.detail: n8n trigger node starts the primary workflow.
Legacy webhook trigger owned by n8n.

flows.name: Daily collection & promotion
flows.trigger: 08:00 JST schedule, n8n manual trigger, or POST /webhook/daily-keyword-summary/request
flows.outcome: Deduplicated daily archive, AI review instructions, structured JSONL, response paths, and next-run automatic keywords.

flows.name: Dashboard exploration
flows.trigger: Browser opens a dashboard, list, detail, or weekly-report page
flows.outcome: Aggregated talents, articles, relations, classifications, feedback, summaries, keywords, and reports are rendered; proposal files are used if core Data Tables are unavailable.

flows.name: Manual keyword management
flows.trigger: User adds, edits, or removes a manual keyword in the dashboard
flows.outcome: config/keywords.json changes atomically and the next default collection uses the new manual list.

flows.name: Automatic keyword management
flows.trigger: User edits the n8n automatic keyword list in the dashboard
flows.outcome: Workflow staticData autoKeywords is updated and used by the next non-overridden collection.

flows.name: AI candidate promotion
flows.trigger: User accepts an Add: yes item from the newest AI candidate Markdown
flows.outcome: The validated candidate is appended to automatic workflow keywords.

flows.name: Article feedback & exclusion
flows.trigger: User approves or rejects an article detail record
flows.outcome: Feedback is persisted, an AI feedback instruction is regenerated, and rejected articles are excluded from later daily outputs/dashboard visibility.

flows.name: Talent/article review & apply
flows.trigger: Daily workflow produces talent-index instructions or an offline generator produces a proposal
flows.outcome: Reviewed articles, talents, and relations are upserted; approved search-enabled names become later default search terms.

flows.name: Article classification review & apply
flows.trigger: Daily workflow produces classification instructions or the offline generator produces a proposal
flows.outcome: Evidence-backed type, category, and relevance rows are stored and displayed.

flows.name: Official roster synchronization
flows.trigger: Operator runs sync_official_talent_registry.py, optionally followed by --apply after review
flows.outcome: Dated official roster audit files are written and reviewed roster entries can be upserted without deletion or automatic individual search enablement.

flows.name: Article body capture & summary backfill
flows.outcome: Normalized article content/status is archived, optionally synced to article_contents, and complete runs can regenerate verified summaries.

flows.name: Offline review output generation
flows.outcome: Coverage-checked proposal files or current feedback instructions are produced for review.

flows.name: Structured backfill & weekly analysis
flows.trigger: Operator backfills historical digests or generates a selected/latest ISO week
flows.outcome: Structured JSONL, weekly trends, and keyword-quality reports are generated and weekly research reports are browsable.

flows.name: Workflow deployment
flows.trigger: Operator runs sync_workflow_to_n8n.py for a selected exported workflow
flows.outcome: The selected local workflow structure is validated and created/updated remotely while runtime static data is preserved by normal updates.

flows.name: Feedback table bootstrap
flows.outcome: article_feedback exists with the expected schema; an existing table is unchanged.

flows.name: Legacy article brief
flows.outcome: A normalized article brief is produced in execution data; the repository marks this path as superseded.
